version.changelog:
- Added ZHIPU_API_KEY to the required environment variables in the metadata section.
- No other changes; all documentation and catalog content remain the same.

llm.summary: A documentation-only guide that declares a required ZHIPU_API_KEY environment variable — unnecessary for a pure README and disproportionate to its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly documentation-only and contains no code or install steps, yet its metadata lists ZHIPU_API_KEY as a required environment variable. A master/guide skill should not need an API key to present links and install instructions; this requirement is unexplained and disproportionate.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md stays within documentation scope: it lists skills, shows example install commands (npx clawhub / git clone) and tells an agent to open target skills' SKILL.md. It does not instruct reading local files or sweeping system data. However, the agent guidance to 'open the selected skill's SKILL.md and follow its instructions' can cascade into other skills that may request additional credentials — users should inspect those target SKILL.md files before following instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files are present; this is instruction-only, which minimizes direct install risk. The recommended install methods (npx clawhub, git clone from GitHub) are normal but inherently involve running third-party code — standard caution applies.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only ZHIPU_API_KEY is declared as required, but the master skill itself doesn't use it — the KEY is only noted as commonly used by downstream GLM skills. Marking it as required at the master-skill level is disproportionate and could cause the platform to request/store an API key unnecessarily. The SKILL.md does show how to set the key, which is expected for GLM usage, but declaring it as required here is misleading.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No elevated persistence is requested: always:false, no install, and no modifications to other skills or system settings. Agent invocation is allowed (default) which is normal for skills and not by itself concerning.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
This skill is a README-style guide and contains no executable code, which lowers direct risk. However, it unnecessarily declares ZHIPU_API_KEY as a required environment variable — you should not provide that API key just because this master skill requests it. Instead:
- Review each target skill's own SKILL.md before installing or supplying credentials.
- Prefer installing from the official GitHub repos listed, and inspect package contents (or the npm package) before running npx installs.
- Only set ZHIPU_API_KEY if you trust the specific GLM skill you're installing and understand what access the key grants.
- If you plan to install multiple GLM skills, consider using least-privilege or scoped keys when possible and avoid storing long-lived secrets in global shell config until you've verified each skill.
If you control the skill metadata, remove ZHIPU_API_KEY from required.env in this master skill (or make it optional) so the platform won't prompt for a secret that the guide itself doesn't need.
